column3: #2646 closed: LocalStorage.CreateShareRecord now runs its upsert and a FOR SHARE re-read of the live secret in one transaction and rolls back if the secret is gone; DeleteSecret UPDATEs (locks) the secret row before its #370 share cascade, so every interleaving either fails the share or lets the cascade see it. Ownership side remains serial-equivalent. Proven: TestCTAReview_ShareSecret_vs_DeleteSecret_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestCTAReview_ShareSecret_DeleteSecretAfterInsert_CrossReplicaPostgres.
